summary: "Cenizas" by Grazia Deledda is a novel published in 1903-1904. In the Sardinian countryside, fifteen-year-old Rosalia falls for Anania, a dreamer who turns out to be married. When her father discovers her pregnancy, he casts her out. Years later, she leaves her young son at his father's door and disappears.
